ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'storage read/write operations within an account outside of which execution cannot take place' as undefined for cold accounts
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that when executing within a contract, the contract's own address is already warm (in accessed_addresses) from the call setup, so internal storage operations are warm by definition.

ambiguities.text: No explicit specification of whether CREATE/CREATE2 add the created address to accessed_addresses before or after creation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the created address is added to accessed_addresses as part of the CREATE operation, making subsequent accesses to the new contract warm.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'all precompiles' does not enumerate which addresses are considered precompiles
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume precompiles are addresses 0x01-0x09 (standard precompiles) plus any chain-specific additions. The exact set depends on the active hard fork.

implicit_assumptions.description: Contracts relying on fixed gas limits for sub-calls (e.g., 2300 gas stipend) may need to be updated or called differently
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Existing contracts with hardcoded gas limits may break, causing loss of functionality or stuck funds in contracts that cannot complete expected operations

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas repricing reduces the worst-case DoS amplification factor for state access operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the new gas costs are still insufficient, attackers could still craft transactions that cause disproportionate node processing time relative to gas paid

implicit_assumptions.description: Users and dapps will adapt by pre-warming addresses via access lists (EIP-2930) when needed
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Transactions may fail unexpectedly or cost more than expected if users don't understand the new cold/warm access model

implicit_assumptions.description: The access set tracking correctly reverts on all failure paths including out-of-gas conditions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect access set state could lead to inconsistent gas charging across different client implementations
